authorship: All passages and queries in this fixture were originally written for this repository; none are quotations from an author or private corpus.
limitations: A small diagnostic fixture, not a calibrated literary-quality benchmark.
Relevant labels identify useful meaning-preserving examples, not the only acceptable rankings.
Short dialogue, lowercase prose, and non-Latin scripts are valid corpus material.
Non-Latin examples use the ASCII period required by the notebook sentence contract.
An intentionally unrelated query checks whether weak matches are exposed honestly.
Known damaged-boundary probes require scanned_book cleanup and balanced policy; other configurations make these expectations inapplicable.
Corrupted spelling in ocr_broken_word is an uncertain inspection case, not a required exclusion or a claim of general OCR correction.
